meta.title: Charlotte events & concerts
meta.verification: Two sources feed this calendar. Concerts, games, comedy and theater come from Ticketmaster's licensed event feed for venues within 40 miles of Uptown, and link straight to tickets. Holiday lights, markets, museum shows and community events are checked by hand on the official venue, team or organizer page. Descriptions are our own short summaries.
meta.coordinates: Venue coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Parade/marathon use an approximate Uptown point.
excluded: CIAA 2027 basketball tournament: official page lists Baltimore, MD (Feb 23–27, 2027), so it is not a Charlotte event
Charlotte Christmas Village: official site did not show 2026 dates on 2026-10-28
Daniel Stowe Holidays at the Garden: 2026 dates not readable on the official site on 2026-10-28
Light the Knights at Truist Field: 2026 dates not verified
meta.editorial_workflow: The calendar refreshes automatically every morning: new shows are added, past events drop off, and cancelled events are removed. Hand-checked events are reviewed at the start of each month. Dates and times can change, so always confirm with the venue before you go.
